faqs.question: Where are your screens located?
faqs.answer: Our indoor digital billboards are in popular local businesses across {city} and the Mid-Cities, including restaurants, coffee and dessert shops, gyms and training studios, barbershops, and entertainment venues. Check the map above to see our current host partners.

faqs.question: How do I get my ad on your screens?
faqs.answer: It's easy! Reach out to our team and we'll walk you through the options, create your custom full-motion ad, and get you live across the screen advertising network locations that best match your audience.

faqs.question: Can my business host a screen?
faqs.answer: If you run a busy local business, absolutely. Host partners get a full-screen ad inside their own location, their ads played at other nearby non-competing hosts, and more. Learn how to become a host partner.
